metaTitle: Custom Sublimation Luggage Accessories | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom sublimation luggage accessories for vibrant, all-over designs. Perfect for events, teams, and corporate gifts at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Sublimation printing allows for full-color, edge-to-edge designs that won't peel or crack, making it ideal for custom luggage accessories like passport holders, luggage tags, and travel pouches. This decoration method is perfect for creating vibrant, photo-quality branding that stands out at airports or trade shows. Whether you need a bold logo or a detailed pattern, sublimation delivers lasting color and a smooth finish on polyester-based materials.
heroAltText: Custom sublimation luggage accessories with full-color all-over print on a luggage tag and passport holder
